preconditions.description: The number of intervals is less than or equal to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= y <= 1000 for interval in intervals for x, y in interval)
preconditions.description: Each interval's start and end are within the range [0, 1000].

postconditions.description: The output list contains at least zero intervals.

postconditions.expression: all(x <= y for interval in output for x, y in interval)
postconditions.description: Each interval in the output is sorted with start <= end.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(x <= y <= a <= b for (a, b) in output for x, y in interval) for interval in intervals if not any(x <= y <= a <= b for (a, b) in output for x, y in interval))
postconditions.description: No interval in the input overlaps with any interval in the output.
The output intervals are sorted by their start values.
